utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly tools and a few warm blankets, if anyone has extras. I can sort and set things out quietly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring a couple blankets and check my toolbox. What time should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the exact drop-off time and what tools we need first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the drop-off time and list the tools first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d rather pin down the drop-off time first, then I can make a clean list of tools and bring what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. What did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, just the usual chaos—I think they were collecting tools and spare parts, but I might be mixing it up. I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help. I keep losing track of these things.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—if you find out they still need anything, let me know and I can drop it off too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll check in later and tell you if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably running a bit late again, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — could you grab the drill, a roll of duct tape, and the blue toolbox? I’ve got the rest covered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I’ve got it — drill, duct tape, and the blue toolbox. I’ll head over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what’s the schedule, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send out a simple schedule today, and I could use your help coordinating tools, volunteers, and a quick signup list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — send the schedule, and I’ll help keep the tools and signup list organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help — let’s start by listing what needs fixing and who can take each job.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll list the repairs and the folks who can handle them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what’s the main thing you need right now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m mainly trying to pin down the exact location for the repair drive so people can find it easily. If you have the address or landmark, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the exact address yet, but I can check with the folks organizing it and send you the best landmark as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you start by helping me make a quick list of the repair needs, then we’ll match them to volunteers and supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll start a quick list of the repair needs and then we can line them up with volunteers and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got some supplies we can spare for the repair drive. Tell me what you need most, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’m skimming here, but basics first: tape, screws, and a couple of hand tools would help most. If you’ve got any spare gloves or trash bags too, I’d take those.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can spare tape, screws, a couple hand tools, and some gloves and trash bags too. I’ll set them aside for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I’m keeping an ear out. If you want, I can check around and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I’m happy to help out however I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Rey — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, can you tell me the exact time and what kind of repairs they’re collecting for?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I don’t have the exact time yet, but I’m checking and will send it as soon as I know. They’re collecting small household repairs like broken toys, loose chairs, and basic appliance fixes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Please send me the exact time when you have it, and I’ll decide then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just the flyer text and the drop-off details—I can spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can send you the flyer text and drop-off details in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and repeat the plan to folks nearby.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll keep coordinating here and make sure everyone knows the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan to neighbors and make sure the repair drive gets around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—did something change? I might’ve missed the update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, a little—it’s still happening, but I’m keeping it low-key for now. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just keep me posted if it shifts. I’ll try not to miss the next update.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive, but I can help if you want to go over it together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools we can use, and I’m happy to go over it with you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. Let’s take it step by step, and I’ll learn as we go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive organized. I can help keep the list tidy and make sure everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep track of the locations and send you the list so we can keep everyone moving the right way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll keep everything sorted for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and where things are being dropped off first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally — it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2, and we’re dropping everything off at the community center on Maple. I’ll send you the exact details so you can swing by when it works for you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks — please send the exact drop-off details, and I’ll see if I can make that window.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely still on for the repair drive, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on — I’m just checking the details first so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — just wanted to confirm we’re still good.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — let’s keep it simple and set a clear plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll swing by a little late, but I can still help get it organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No trouble — just come by when you can, and we’ll sort it out step by step.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon, but I’m still catching up on the details. Do you know what they need help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m not sure yet, but I can check what supplies they’re asking for and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great — I’m still piecing it together from second-hand updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder of what I promised again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You said you’d help sort donations and hand out the tools at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes — sort the donations and hand out the tools. Thanks for reminding me; I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — it’s at the community center from 3 to 5. If you can help with the school schedule and sign-in table, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I can cover the sign-in table and work around school pickup. I’ll be there from 3 to 5 at the community center.
